speaker: narrator
text: Jakob sets down his ledger. You found the right column, he says. He hands you holy water, and asks to be locked in.

speaker: narrator
text: Andrei sits down on the stair. The voice promised him his sister would be spared. He will not open a door for it again.

speaker: narrator
text: Marta turns the key over in her hand. You know, then. When you reach his bridge, it will come down without a sound.

speaker: narrator
text: The wrong name. The one you accused only stares at you. Somewhere on the hill, someone is laughing.

speaker: narrator
text: Jakob kept his ledger open all along. He sold him your road, and he is already on it.

speaker: narrator
text: At the burgomaster's house, Andrei lifts the latch and stands aside. He was promised mercy. The mist goes in.

speaker: narrator
text: At the castle, the little gate is barred from inside. Marta has gone up to pour his wine, and will not come down again.
